name: PicPak 4.2" BWRY e-paper frame
description: Battery-powered 4.2" 4-colour BWRY (black/white/red/yellow) e-paper frame. Community firmware by varanu5 speaks Tesserae's REST device API and paints frames the esp32_bin renderer packs to 2-bpp BWRY.
notes_md: Community firmware by [varanu5](https://github.com/varanu5/picpak-tesserae-client). Stable as of the current build; ongoing stress-testing by the author.
